title: MIA enrollment grant (ADR-0025)
description: The exact UTF-8 bytes of this object are signed with ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace mia-grant. Unknown claims are ignored; a missing claim is refused. Every *_fp is the OpenSSH form SHA256:<base64> printed by ssh-keygen -lf. Times are Unix seconds.

exp.description: Grant validity ends (minutes after iat). The Pi refuses now >= exp.

jti.description: Unique grant ID; the Pi accepts each once.

account_id.description: Opaque MIA account ID (ADR-0024); no Stripe identifier.

entitlement_exp.description: When the paid entitlement ends; not the grant's validity.
